cases.title: Verify I see 3 orders listed with the newest first

preconditions: I am logged in and have placed 3 orders

steps: I open "My orders"
cases.expected: I see at most 20 orders per page and a link to the next page
preconditions: I am logged in and have placed 25 orders

steps: Set up data so the scenario involves 20 orders
I open "My orders"
cases.expected: The rule holds exactly at the limit

cases.title: Changing the record id in the URL does not expose another customer's data
steps: Log in as customer A
Open a URL containing customer B's record id
cases.expected: Access is denied and no data belonging to customer B is shown
